additional_info.subject: RE: 0409734 - ID0409734-DC/Si-D/AR-[MP / R6 170002130] Issues with remote updates - Sicharge D CRM:00641001168
additional_info.body:
Dear
Abhinav
For the moment, the problem is resolved, however the client is having problems when making the charge by QR CODE.
At exit 1 (Chademo) first authorize the charge by scanning the QR and then connect the vehicle to charge.
However, for output 2 (CCS2) the process is reversed, you must first connect the cable and then activate the charge by scanning the QR. And this is not shown on the charger screen.
Saludos
/
Best Regards /
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
